Table 3 provides the requirements for heat-pump-only efficiency and capacity during the CVP. The instantaneous efficiency and capacity measured during CVP stable periods was to meet the steady-state test values accounting for the tolerance described in Table 3. Table 3: Heat pump capacity and efficiency thresholds for the CVP Outdoor Air Temperature COP2 Tolerance Measured Capacity Steady-State Test (°F) Tolerance -10 H-10Max 5 -10% ±10% H5Max 47 H47L 2.2 LABORATORY SETUP All equipment was tested in environmental chambers, consisting of an indoor (ID) and outdoor (OD) chamber installed in a side-by-side arrangement. The UUT was installed in the outdoor chamber with supply and return ductwork communicating with the indoor chamber. Both prototypes were tested in the downflow airflow configuration. The test configurations followed the requirements specified in ASHRAE 37-2009 [3]. The primary capacity measurement for all systems was the ID air enthalpy method. The secondary test method was the refrigerant enthalpy method.
